Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

translations.web: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
translations.bsb: The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
translations.asv: The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
